3) Token mix: avg tokens per request and % of long (>1k) flows?

1) Peak TPS: ~30 TPS during heavy traffic (batch of users), average TPS: ~10 TPS.
2) Latency target: p95 end-to-end ~1.5s for chat flows; token latency less prescriptive but ideally under 200ms/token at p95.
3) Token mix: Avg request ~150 tokens total (prompt+completion). ~20% of requests are long-form with ~1k tokens. Daily token volume ~5M tokens.
4) GPU preference: we would prefer H100 if cost is reasonable — we know it helps latency for larger models. Primary constraint is predictable monthly spend; procurement timeline is Q2.

Thanks for the details, Sarah — good data point. Initial sizing notes / assumptions based on: peak 30 TPS, avg 10 TPS, concurrency ~20, token mix (150 avg, 20% long ~1k tokens):

- Short answer: Dedicated with H100s will give the best p95 latency headroom. If H100 is constrained or cost is a concern, A100-80GB is a viable alternative with more nodes.

Sizing (provisional):
- H100 config: 4 x H100-80GB nodes (serving optimally with batching + KV cache) should meet 30 TPS peak with p95 token latency target given our tuned kernels and dynamic batching. This assumes model quantization/FP16 and session-level KV caching.
- A100 alternative: ~8 x A100-80GB nodes with more aggressive batching to hit throughput; expect slightly higher p95 due to kernel differences.
- Concurrency handling: target concurrency of 20 means we need warm KV caches and pre-warmed model workers; recommended autoscale floor to keep cache hits high.
- Long-form handling: for the 20% long-form requests (~1k tokens), consider separating into a dedicated worker pool or route to batched lower-latency nodes to avoid tail impact.

Open questions that materially affect sizing/cost:
- Sequence length distribution beyond the 20% long-form: e.g., do you have many 2–3k token flows?
- Batching tolerance: are you able to tolerate small increases in per-request latency in exchange for 2–3x better cost?
- Model family and size (did you plan to use a 7B/13B/70B variant)? Larger models change GPU RAM and throughput tradeoffs.

I've attached a quick capacity_estimate.xlsx (stub) with the above numbers and cost delta H100 vs A100. Happy to run a short sizing workshop to lock down exact inputs.

Attachment: capacity_estimate.xlsx

— Lauren
